projects.title: Desk Research
projects.description:
These sources mainly focus on the materials, manufacturing, lifespan, repair, and disposal of headphones. Research shows that most of a headphone’s climate impact comes from the manufacturing process, while replacing batteries or parts and extending its lifespan can reduce environmental impact. Other examples also show that repairable design can be more important than simply using “green” materials. For example, some headphones can be charged by solar energy but are still difficult to repair or recycle. I plan to show the process of headphones being used, breaking, taken apart, and repaired to connect these ideas into one story.

1.The Climate Impact of the Usage of Headphones and Headsets
2.Useful metals recovery from electronic scraps of headphones – A sustainable approach
3.From Waste to Worth: The Case for Modular and Upgradable Electronics in a Sustainable Future.
4.Reparability Scoring System – Product relevance scoping study (2025)
5.Fairbuds XL review: the excellent noise-cancelling headphones you can fix yourself
6.Sony 1000XX the Collexion headphones review: supreme comfort and quiet luxury for your ears
